# QuizFlow AI

> AI-powered quiz funnel builder for TikTok, Instagram, and Meta Ads. Generate high-converting interactive quizzes for paid social in minutes.

QuizFlow AI helps creators, media buyers, ecommerce brands, and agencies replace static landing pages with AI-generated quiz funnels optimized for paid social advertising.

## Pages

- [Home](https://quizflow.ai/): Product overview, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, and how it works.
- [Sign in](https://quizflow.ai/login): Account login (private).
- [Dashboard](https://quizflow.ai/app): Authenticated workspace (private).
